addins.name: GitPane
addins.description: Visual Git integration for the Clarion IDE. A dockable pane providing commit, push, pull, branch management, stash, history, and merge conflict resolution directly within Clarion.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: Flatten Code
addins.description: Flattens Clarion line continuations (|) into single logical lines. Collapses adjacent string literals joined with & and restores caret position. Available via Ctrl+Shift+F, Edit → Format menu, and editor context menus — only shown when the caret is inside a continuation block.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: List Format Parser
addins.description: Parses and cleans the FORMAT() attribute of a Clarion LIST control. Provides 'Parse List Format' in the context menu, 'Clean List Format' and 'Format FROM Selections' in Edit → Format, and 'Copy FROM as CASE' / 'Copy FROM as CHOOSE' in the Edit menu and context menus — all commands are condition-gated to the relevant attribute.
addins.author: msarson

addins.name: Clarion Markdown Editor
addins.description: Markdown file viewer and editor for the Clarion IDE with split-pane live preview, syntax highlighting, tabbed multi-file editing, and dark mode sync.
addins.author: msarson
